title: Outline The Hollow Beneath Emberfall starter module
description:
Design the small first-party starter module - The Hollow Beneath Emberfall - at outline level before authoring the full fixture.

The outline should identify the adventure premise, starting hook, key locations, NPC roles, likely scenes, objectives, secrets, encounter concepts, reward, and possible endings.
design:
Keep this intentionally small. Avoid turning the starter module into a campaign arc.

Naming (ADR 0012): the setting is Emberfall (campaign template); the module is The Hollow Beneath Emberfall (scenario). "Ember Hollow" is informal shorthand only, not a separate place. EMBERFALL_HOLLOW is the legacy conflated sample.

Possible placeholder concept:
A local disturbance near Emberfall reveals an old sealed place below a mundane landmark. The module should demonstrate how authored secrets, keyed locations, NPC motives, and player divergence are handled by the engine.
acceptance_criteria:
- The module has a title (The Hollow Beneath Emberfall), premise, intended level range, intended party assumptions, and short summary.
- The outline identifies 3 to 5 keyed locations.
- The outline identifies at least one social encounter, one exploration obstacle, and one combat-capable encounter.
- The outline identifies secrets/clues and which scenes or locations can reveal them.
- The outline identifies objectives and ending states.
- The outline explicitly ties the module to the Emberfall setting without expanding Emberfall into a full adventure script.
